page.layout: One printed page. A faint heading across the top. Below it, a synopsis or diagram with braces in the centre of the page, largely unreadable. A vertical line of letters runs down the left margin, which is a note. The right edge shows the neighbouring page and is left out.
page.notes: The scan is very faint and mostly illegible. The vertical marginal word in the left margin reads roughly c, n, n, a, n, N, a, d, p, h, n, and I cannot make out its meaning. The heading and the diagram labels could not be read with any certainty, so their word counts are estimates. The diagram is a synopsis with braces, transcribed as outline lines with the depth estimated from the drawing. Show-through from the reverse side and the neighbouring page's edge are left out.
